notes.title: 🎉Kimono Cats have finally come🎉
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, arcade lovers!🌸[/h2][p][/p][p align="justify"][b]You are in a perfect place to spend some of your free time.[/b][/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Starting today ([b]14th of August),[/b] you can experience [b]a combination of cats, Japan, and festive vibes [/b]on [b][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3065080/Kimono_Cats/"]Steam[/url][/u]. [/b]Excited yet?[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/916d88253acea7b199e09a6bafb2ca554fa47b4d.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]😸[b][i]Kimono Cats[/i] takes you on a trip to Matsuri inspired festival, where you can try out various attractions![/b][/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]👾There you can play [b]18 different mini-games[/b], but that’s not all, there are also[b] BUBBLES[/b] to pop! [b]112 of them[/b], isn’t it awesome? 
[/p][p align="justify"]What’s inside them, you may wonder. Well, why don’t you find out yourself? [b]Fun guaranteed![/b]
[/p][p align="justify"]🏡And if you decide to relax even more, you can [b]decorate your space[/b] with items obtained from the bubbles or the shop! Let your imagination do the work.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]💝 We hope you will enjoy [b][i]Kimono Cats[/i][/b] as much as we do![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/ec2a0d59f3787fe025780e852bd0f7777f92db5d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Devlog 4 – The surprising path to the Cat Festival
notes.content:
[h2]Well done travelers! 
[/h2][p]We are at the point where you are about to [b]start your Matsuri adventure[/b]! Can you hear the festival music around the corner? 🎶🎊 [/p][p]But before you join in the joyous fun, let us share one last story with you – a story about the not-so-obvious evolution of [i]Kimono Cats[/i]. 🐱✨[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/4777ef5d5f96b95c935d11aaa71656ca6197b16a.png"][/img][/p][p]Greg has been making indie games for over 40 years 🎮 – starting in 1983, with his first project ([i]Starflight[/i]) released in 1986. Over the decades, he's realised that game development is rarely smooth, and not as fun as it seems. Creative disagreements, missed deadlines, publisher demands, or team-related issues – something always gets in the way...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/edb84977da6ae1eb26a8c5deb3bcf6e7157a3343.png"][/img][/p][p][b]But [i]Kimono Cats[/i] turned out to be the exception. [/b]🌸[/p][p]From start to finish, the project ran unusually smoothly. The entire team – including their producer, [b]Riley Lallo[/b] (another wonderful person), 💖 worked in perfect sync in short, fun 🎉, and productive meetings. They were self-funded for most of the development, which gave them the total creative freedom and when funding finally came from Apple Arcade, the team had the publisher's complete trust and made the game the way they wanted it. 🙌 ✨[/p][p][b][i]Kimono Cats was simply a rare kind of project – built with joy 💖, trust 🤝, and a dream team. 🌈With totally no mishaps to share. 😺[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/541a79653dfd5baca890be1a82aab7debb43af03.png"][/img][/p][p]Since then, the same team has been working on a new title called [i]Dancing with Ghosts[/i]. Once again, the collaboration has been incredibly smooth. Unfortunately, as is often the case in indie development, funding remains a challenge and Greg has had to temporarily part ways with most of the team. Maintaining enough funding to keep teams afloat in today's gaming industry is a challenge.[/p][p]Hopefully, that will change soon. 🤞 Because when the right people come together, great things happen! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/29ae219a38ac0dff91e0917b458ac44d06ae1747.png"][/img][/p][h3]Thank you for being with us on this unique journey through the world of [i]Kimono Cats. [/i]🐱[/h3][h3]In the meantime, we won't take up any more of your time – put on your festive kimonos 👘 and head out for a one-of-a-kind date at the Matsuri Festival! Have fun! 💖🎉[/h3]

notes.title: Fall in Love at the Matsuri Festival!
notes.content: [h2]Hey everyone!🌸[/h2][p][/p][h3]We have some news you've been waiting for for a long time![/h3][p][/p][p][i]Kimono Cats[/i] – a heartwarming festival-themed adventure – has received an official release date. This uplifting invitation for a trip to the heart of vibrant, old Japan will begin on August 14th! 👘🐈[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/1b9f5bb6befcf7a7f9701362a3859dc60dad108d.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Soon you will have the opportunity to join a charming cat couple and take part in a one-of-a-kind Matsuri festival! 😻[/b][/p][p][i]Kimono Cats[/i] skillfully combines the carefree popping of balloons with social cooperation and a gentle romance system. Participate in lighthearted mini-games, interact with intriguing characters, and build the purrfect dream village ❤️Join a charming cat couple, to take part in the Matsuri festival! 🎉[/p]

notes.title: Devlog 3 – Introducing the characters of Kimono Cats
notes.content:
[h2]Hey future Matsuri-goers! 🐱💕[/h2][p][/p][p]We’re already halfway there! So let's pause for a while to gather strength for the rest of the journey and listen to a new story.🎐[/p][p]This time you’ll learn a little more about [b]the art of Kimono Cats[/b] and some of the wonderful participants of our festival! 😻😸[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/b50d7760f5d4d471ea70f1df0449ef55734ac7fd.png"][/img][/p][p]As mentioned before, two artists from Thailand are behind the game's artwork – [b]Ferrari Duanghathai[/b] and [b]Tanta Vorawatanakul[/b]. Both are huge fans of Japanese culture, with a wonderful imagination and incredible skills. 🎨[/p][p]The overall look of [i]Kimono Cats[/i] is entirely their own idea – Greg just described the general vibe while the artists came up with the original style, with little or no direction. 🪭🌈
[/p][p]One of the key concepts that motivated Greg and the developers while designing the Matsuri cat date was the desire to make the game [b]openly supportive of LGBTQ themes 🏳️‍🌈[/b]. Therefore, they included a wide range of feline characters – both gender-neutral and strictly male or female – with no limitations on who could romance whom. ❤️[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/f489308ec23c70377db32178b63768f7067aba68.jpg"][/img][/p][p]To further emphasize the message, they put a rainbow up over the heads of two kitties every time they kissed. It’s a gentle but clear celebration of same-sex and gender-diverse relationships.
[/p][p]As you may have guessed, making this one simple decision had consequences. [i]Kimono Cats[/i] couldn’t be marketed in 26 countries. But Greg and the team felt it was the right thing to do. [/p][p]Kitty love for everybody! 💖🐾😻
[/p][p]It's time to move on – the festival is getting closer! 🚶‍♀️🎉[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/ec2a0d59f3787fe025780e852bd0f7777f92db5d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Devlog 2 – Designing the Kimono Cats Matsuri Festival
notes.content:
[h2]Hey tireless travelers! 🎉🌸[/h2][p]
We're getting closer and closer to our destination, but there's still a bit of road ahead before we reach the [b]magical Matsuri[/b]. [/p][p]In the meantime, [b]let's stop for a moment, take a breath, and listen to another story. [/b]😌[b]🙏[/b] [/p][p]This time you'll hear a bit about the different sides of [i]Kimono Cats[/i] design. 🎨🐾[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/a89073864e35e5a8a89be55cbedaf3a194293ae9.png"][/img][/p][p]Greg poured care into the smallest detail of [i]Kimono Cats[/i], so as to convey its [b]cultural depth[/b] as faithfully as possible. This wouldn’t have been possible without the invaluable help of the exceptional people who assisted him in this project. 😻👘 [/p][p] [/p][p]A true master of minigames assisted in the creation of festival activities at [i]Kimono Cats[/i]. [b][u][url="https://www.ferryhalim.com/"]Ferry Halim[/url][/u][/b] is the lead programmer of the game and also a hugely experienced designer of literally hundreds of mobile games. He easily brought Greg's ideas for mini-games to life. ✨[/p][p](Greg’s favorite mini-games? Catching Fish 🐟 or Runaway Ramen 🍜 – he just couldn’t decide!)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/f0aba51ba763d338d81c5deaec520eb417927be5.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]The accurate portrayal of the Matsuri tradition was overseen by Greg's friend from Japan 🗾– [b]Mamiko Suehiro[/b]. With her deep cultural knowledge 🎎, Mamiko reviewed every aspect of the game, making suggestions and changes, perfecting the smallest detail of the game.🏮[/p][p][/p][p]As for the vibrant look of the festival itself – that’s the work of two incredibly talented female artists from Thailand. But more about that in the next story. [/p][p][/p][p]Time to get back on the road! 🌈🐱[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/474ffa88710ae3665e18d69ae9688f48e6a34ddd.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Devlog 1 – Shaping the World of Kimono Cats
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone👋,[/h2][p][/p][h3]Today, you're coming with us to a festival. And not just any festival. [/h3][h3][b]The Japanese Matsuri Festival! [/b]🎊[/h3][h3]
[/h3][p]Everyone is invited, and all are welcome. So pack your bags – you’re in for a celebration like you’ve never experienced before! 🏮[/p][p]But before we get there, [b]four special stops await us. [/b]🌸 At each one, you’ll learn a little more about the celebration that lies ahead – and the world of [i]Kimono Cats[/i] that makes it all possible.[/p][p]As our festival journey begins, let us take you back to where it all started: the very first spark of the idea that shaped the world of [i]Kimono Cats. [/i]👘🐱[/p][p][/p][p][b]So take a seat (and don’t get your kimono dusty [/b]👘[b]) – it’s story time. [/b]✨[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/d81de2eafc396407a53a30d0eb02b948cb2934c0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The idea for the game came from a pure need of the heart of its developer [b]Greg Johnson[/b], in the face of hard pandemic times. Surrounded by constant anxiety and isolated from the world, he began working on an idea for a [b]game full of warmth and positive relationships[/b]. There, both he and his wife, as well as many other players, could find a personal sanctuary of peace in unpredictable lockdown times. 🌈☀️[/p][p][/p][p]This is how [i]Kimono Cats[/i] was brought to life. The decision regarding the world and its characters came easily to Greg. As the owner of two cats 🐈🐈‍⬛, fluent in Japanese, he set the feline characters on a [b]date during the Matsuri festival[/b] – [b]a magical place he could fill with many mini-games and cultural references[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/6757ed34dd001d0b40b4aed17bc38519ad095770.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Kimono Cats[/i] was originally developed as a mobile game and at the time the market was flooded with games whose core was about revenge, destruction, and retaliation."Without revenge, there is no game; it's what turns players on and keeps them coming back." investors said.[/p][p][/p][p]As you can guess Greg didn't listen to the investors. He believed in the value of his project, and very rightly so. Because of him, we can be on this journey today. 😻🌸[/p][p][/p][h3]And now we're moving on, because the next stop is coming soon! 🍡🪭[/h3][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Kimono Cats is coming in Q3 2025 - stay tuned!
notes.content:
[h2]Kimono Cats is coming to Steam and Nintendo Switch in Q3 2025![/h2]

Hey cozy game lovers! We’ve got some exciting news - Kimono Cats, the adorable feline festival adventure, is making its way to Steam and Nintendo Switch in Q3 2025!

RedDeer.Games, together with developer HumaNature Studios are working hand-in-hand to bring the game to both platforms ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/ef991c1aab63d81cb41ea695bcf17880a66182e2.jpg[/img]

Originally a fan-favorite on Apple Arcade, Kimono Cats is a hand-drawn, heartwarming game where you (and a friend, if you’re playing in co-op!) explore a colorful Matsuri festival as a cute cat in a kimono. Toss lucky coins, play charming mini-games, chat with quirky festival-goers, and just enjoy the wholesome vibes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/54d2da91b249b1813c658a9c2ff6ada5fc60aacb.jpg[/img]

But the fun doesn’t stop at the festival - once you’ve earned some coins, you’ll start building and decorating your own little village. From cozy decorations to silly animals and relaxing surprises, you’ll make it your own little slice of feline paradise. 🏡✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/dac551df20092b4c3809c1108c586162711aebe1.jpg[/img]

We’ll be sharing more updates as we get closer to launch—including platform-specific upgrades and a few extra surprises - [b]like, hmm, a demo version[/b] 👀 Until then, keep your paws ready and your lucky coins polished!

See you soon!
